description: Generated logic-grid puzzle (5 houses, 8 clues, unique solution verified by brute force).

input.message:
There are 5 houses in a row, numbered 1 to 5 from left to right. Each house has a different colour (red, green, blue, amber, violet) and exactly one resident (Ada, Bruno, Chen, Dara, Eli).

Clues:
1. Ada lives in house number 3 (houses are numbered 1 to 5 from left to right).
2. The violet house is directly next to the blue house.
3. Chen lives somewhere to the right of Bruno.
4. Eli lives in house number 5 (houses are numbered 1 to 5 from left to right).
5. Bruno lives in house number 2 (houses are numbered 1 to 5 from left to right).
6. Ada lives in the red house.
7. Chen lives in the green house.
8. Dara does NOT live in the blue house.

Determine, for every house number, who lives there and what colour it is. This puzzle has exactly one solution.

End your answer with one line per house in EXACTLY this format:
House 1: <name> - <colour>
House 2: <name> - <colour>
(and so on)
